calls.title: Jay Janarthanan and Dan Wathne
calls.summary: Jay Janarthanan (buyer) and Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales) discussed upgrading from Pro to Enterprise plan, highlighting key enterprise features like auto-rollback and managed warehouse inclusion that better fit Jay’s usage and budget. Jay raised pain points around pricing justification internally, a potential 20% price increase if not signed by quarter-end, and currency challenges for their New Zealand business. Next steps
